_doc: Front the Zelos operator console's MCP endpoint (/api/mcp) through zelosMCP.
The console (zelosctl web) co-serves an MCP server at /api/mcp: one tool per verb
of every installed zelos.* collection (proxmox__host_prep, kubernetes__platform,
foundry__environment, ...) plus zelos__* job/docs tools and zelos:// resources.
It authenticates exactly like the console REST API:
- local-token mode: Authorization: Bearer <ZELOS_WEB_TOKEN> (printed at startup)
- oidc-proxy mode (in-cluster): the oauth2-proxy/Dex identity headers (put zelosMCP
behind the same gate, or use passthrough).
The backend name 'zelos' becomes the tool prefix Cursor sees: zelos__proxmox__host_prep.
